title: The Pitt
synopsis: The staff of Pittsburgh's Trauma Medical Center work around the clock to save lives in an overcrowded and underfunded emergency department.

episodes.title: 7:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: While attempting to distract himself from the anniversary of his mentor's death, Dr. Robby introduces a fresh batch of interns to life in the ER.

episodes.title: 8:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: Robby helps siblings navigate their elderly father's end of life care. Later, Samira fends off cops targeting a woman with a misunderstood condition.

episodes.title: 9:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: Samira does her best to keep Whitaker on the right track. A teen overdose sparks conflict in the ER.

episodes.title: 10:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: Bets are taken on the whereabouts of a stolen ambulance, while Santos learns a hard lesson, and Whitaker helps to tame “The Kraken.”

episodes.title: 11:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: Santos and Collins each deal with moral quandaries. Samira’s careful approach earns praise from patients – and reproach from Robby.

episodes.title: 12:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: While Robby handles an ultimatum from the hospital, Mel, Javadi, and Collins each handle unique mother-daughter dynamics.

episodes.title: 1:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: After examining an influencer with strange symptoms, Samira pushes back against Robby. Santos contends with a patient accused of assault.

episodes.title: 2:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: While Robby attends to an elderly patient with ties to Pittsburgh's history, other members of the team attempt to resuscitate a young drowning victim.

episodes.title: 3:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: After a staff debrief from Robby, Dana defuses a waiting room brawl, Whitaker finds common ground with "The Kraken," and McKay faces a crucial error.

episodes.title: 4:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: With the Pitt down a staff member, Robby relies on his team to pick up the slack. Later, Santos finally voices her suspicions.

episodes.title: 5:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: While Robby tries to keep a developing staffing situation under wraps, Collins guides a surrogate through a difficult delivery.

episodes.title: 6:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: When dozens of critical patients flood the ER, Robby and his team struggle to keep up amid quickly diminished supplies.

episodes.title: 7:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: On July 4th, Robby meets his replacement for his upcoming sabbatical, and a familiar face returns to the Pitt.

episodes.title: 8:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: While nervously awaiting her deposition, King takes a tumble. Al-Hashimi tries to introduce new technology into the ER.

episodes.title: 9:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: After a motorcycle collision, a husband and wife find themselves in the ER. Later, Robby bonds with a Tree of Life survivor.

episodes.title: 10:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: With a nearby hospital shuttered on the busiest day of the year, Robby and team must field extra patients, including the victim of a parkour mishap.

episodes.title: 11:00 A.M.
episodes.synopsis: As patients continue to pour in, including a local prison inmate, Robby and Langdon must work together to save a beloved patient.

episodes.title: 12:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: As the team deals with a loss, Al-Hashimi and Robby continue to clash over the best course of treatment for a patient showing signs of malnutrition.

episodes.title: 1:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: While Dana tends to a sexual assault victim, Abbot helps an officer injured in the field, and Mohan attempts to keep her uninsured patient in the ER.

episodes.title: 2:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: In the wake of an IT shutdown, Princess must manage a completely analog ER. Al-Hashimi, Mohan, and King assess a woman with sudden blindness.

episodes.title: 3:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: After one of Javadi's patients slips through the cracks, Dana calls in an old friend with experience running a low-tech ER.

episodes.title: 4:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: After an incident at a nearby water park, several critical patients are rushed to the Pitt. Later, Al-Hashimi confronts Robby.

episodes.title: 5:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: While King struggles to cope with her sister's newfound independence, patients and staff are put on edge by an unexpected presence in the ER.

episodes.title: 6:00 P.M.
episodes.synopsis: After she steps up to defend her trainee, Dana clashes with Robby about her methods – and his upcoming sabbatical.
